description: Search the Life Scientific crop-protection catalogue. Filter by free-text query (brand name, tagline, active ingredients, crops and pests), product type, crop, pest/disease/weed target, and/or market/region. Use this for problem-first questions like "what controls septoria in wheat in Ireland?". Returns a compact list of matching products. Pest/disease targets are not yet recorded for every market: if a target search in a market finds nothing, search that market by crop and type instead, and tell the user to confirm the target on the label (get_product_documents). Never conclude that no product controls it.

crop.description: Crop name to match against approved uses (e.g. "wheat", "potatoes").

locale.description: Language for localised prose (taglines, descriptions). Defaults to "en". Regulatory facts are never translated.

query.description: Free-text search over name, tagline, active ingredients, crops and pests/diseases/weeds. Every word must match, in any order (e.g. "septoria wheat"). Best for pests and diseases.

region.description: ISO alpha-2 market code to restrict to (e.g. "gb", "ie", "fr").

target.description: Pest, disease or weed on an approved use in that market (e.g. "septoria", "black-grass"). Singular or plural.

name: search_products
title: Search products
